name: Pylon
description: Customer issues waiting on a response, and a nudge before the first-response SLA runs out.

config.label: API token
config.help: Pylon → Settings → API Tokens. It reads issues, accounts and users; nothing is written back.

config.label: Your Pylon email
config.help: Whose issues count as yours. Leave blank to use the token's own user.

config.label: Sync every (minutes)
config.help: How often to ask Pylon for changes, 1 to 60. Countdowns and reminders still update every minute; a brand-new ticket appears at the next sync. r syncs now.

config.label: Notifications
config.help: on or off. Off keeps the tab and stops the banners.
